clauses.scope_note: Section 2: threshold is greater than 700 million monthly active users, measured for products or services made available by or for Licensee or its affiliates in the preceding calendar month, as of the Llama 3.3 version release date. If the threshold is not exceeded, this paragraph imposes no such restriction.
